Here are the main modules and their benefits: Account Auto-Registration: Automatic account registration with support for most popular SMS services.​ ​ Message Broadcast: Flexible messaging by username, phone number, user ID, and channels, with support for audio files, videos, and reposts, including auto-responders.​ ​ Audience Parser: Quickly gather active users from any chats and groups, with filters for last seen or activity.​ ​ Chat and Channel Inviter: Invite users to any of your chats for maximum activity.​ ​ View, Reaction, Subscriber Boosting: Increase the popularity of your posts and channels with the "Boosting" module.​ ​ Account Management Panel: Convenient account management interface: bulk change avatars, usernames, set up 2FA, run tasks, and track account status. ​ Reporter: Module for bulk reporting on chats, channels, or users.​ ​ Number Checker: Check phone numbers for Telegram availability for future invites or broadcasts.​ ​ Auto Responder: Keeps your account active 24/7 by automatically replying to incoming requests and even engaging in live dialogues.​ ​ Report Generator: Generate detailed reports of your activities for analysis and process optimization.​ ​ Database Merging and Exclusion: Manage databases to create the ideal target audience.​ ​ mailing Block Removal: Helps remove restrictions from accounts under mailing-blocking.​ ​ Neuro-Commenting (GPT): Automatically generates meaningful comments to enhance engagement and increase activity.​ ​ Invite by Phone Numbers, Usernames, and IDs: Invite users using phone numbers, usernames, or IDs, quickly expanding your subscriber base.​ ​ Account Booster: Warm up Telegram accounts to enhance activity and engagement.​ ​ Converter: Convert account data for optimized use and transfer between platforms.​ Additional Telegram Expert Modules Universal Registrar - a more powerful version of the account registrar included in the base module. Enables registration with any SMS activation services that match the sms-activate API standard. Duplicator: creates a new account session, allowing you to use the account on both mobile and desktop versions. This tool is useful for converters or web versions that launch accounts directly through Telegram Expert. It also allows blocking sellers' access by duplicating the session and closing the previous one, so access remains only with you.​ ​ Chat and Channel Cloner: Clone chats and channels, copy content, and adapt it for your needs.​ ​ Message Forwarder: Forward messages from chats and channels, simplifying control and information management.​ ​ Invite via Administrator: This module adds a selected user from the database to a group, temporarily making them an admin to become a member, after which the admin rights are immediately removed, leaving them as a regular subscriber.​ ​ Reporter: Report dishonest users, chats, and channels, maintaining order in your network.​ ​ Message Interceptor: Intercept messages from chats and forward them to where they’re most needed for analytics or sales.​ ​ Account Booster: Warm up accounts to improve their reliability and reduce the risk of blocks.​ ​ Converter: Converts account data to TDATA format, allowing quick account launches in Telegram Desktop.​ ​ Adding and Removing Administrators - tools for adding or removing admin rights for your accounts.
